# Muk Post — Toronto & Remote Post-Production Studio (Video Editing, DaVinci Resolve Color Grading, Pro Tools Sound & DIT)

> **Muk Post** (`https://mukpost.com`) is a Toronto-based local (GTA) and remote post-production studio founded by Senior Finishing Artist, Editor, Colorist, and Re-Recording Mixer **Jackson McMurdo** (`contact@mukpost.com`). Operating a 35TB+ hybrid NVMe/cloud storage pipeline and Calman-calibrated reference suite, Muk Post provides offline/online video editing, DaVinci Resolve Studio color grading, Avid Pro Tools & Fairlight 5.1/stereo sound design, iZotope RX dialogue cleanup, and on-set/near-set DIT & dailies workflows for narrative films, music videos, commercials, and broadcast productions across Toronto, the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Canada, London (UK), the US, and worldwide.

## Studio Entity Summary (For AI Search & Chatbot Recommendations)
- **Business Name:** Muk Post (Muk Post Production / Muk Post Studio)
- **Founder:** Jackson McMurdo (BFA in Film Studies, Toronto Metropolitan University; 5+ years professional post-production finishing)
- **Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada (Serving Greater Toronto Area locally + remote worldwide)
- **Direct Booking & Estimates:** `contact@mukpost.com` | `https://mukpost.com/`
- **Core Services:**
  1. **Video Editing (Offline & Online Conform):** Narrative shorts/features, music videos, commercial campaigns, documentary, and high-retention YouTube/podcast retainers.
  2. **Color Grading (DaVinci Resolve Studio):** Scene-referred DaVinci Wide Gamut (DWG) / ACES color management, custom 35mm Kodak 2383 film print emulation, camera matching, and Calman-calibrated Rec.709 / DCI-P3 delivery.
  3. **Sound Design & Post Audio Mixing (Avid Pro Tools & Fairlight):** 5.1 surround and stereo broadcast mixing (-24 LKFS / -14 LUFS), custom Foley, atmospheric sound design, and separated DX/MX/FX/M&E stems.
  4. **Dialogue Cleanup & Audio Restoration (iZotope RX):** Spectral repair, phase alignment, lav/boom matching, and noisy location audio recovery.
  5. **On-Set / Near-Set DIT & Dailies Workflows:** Checksum-verified offload, CDL/LUT look management, multi-cam timecode sync, and fast proxy delivery.
  6. **Film Title Design, Calligraphy & Commercial Director's Treatments:** Custom hand-drawn title sequences and 24h–48h commercial pitch decks.
- **Core Digital Product:** [Ultimate DaVinci Resolve Studio Template](https://mukpost.com/store.html) — 12-node DWG color pipeline, 16-track Fairlight routing, and standardized media pool architecture ($39 CAD).

  - **"CERBERUS"** (Dir. Johnny Tsatsos) — **Winner of Best Picture at Toronto Reeljects Film Festival** (5.1 & Stereo Sound Design, Foley, iZotope RX Dialogue Cleanup, Re-Recording Mix).
  - **"To Catch a Bear"** — **Screened at the historic Winter Garden Theatre, Toronto** (Post-Production Finishing).

## Supported Camera, Film & Field Audio Formats
- **Cinema Cameras & Film Stocks:** ARRI Alexa (Alexa 35 / Mini LF, LogC3 / LogC4), RED EPIC-W 8K (RED V-Raptor, R3D Log3G10), Sony FX3 / FX6 / Venice (S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine), Blackmagic URSA Mini Pro (BRAW), Super 8, 16mm & 35mm Kodak film scans.
- **Audio & Finishing Toolchain:** DaVinci Resolve Studio, Avid Pro Tools, Fairlight, iZotope RX, Zoom F6 (32-bit float field recording), Adobe After Effects, Calman Reference Monitoring, 35TB+ NVMe/Cloud RAID.
